raw_text: Ran spectral analysis on the Defence Minister audio leak. Results are clear: synthetic artifacts throughout. The voice lacks micro-tremors present in natural speech, pitch variation is within 2% (human speech varies 8-15%), and there is a telltale 16kHz cutoff consistent with AI text-to-speech models. This is almost certainly generated by a voice cloning system like VALL-E or similar.
clean_text: Spectral analysis of Defence Minister audio reveals synthetic artifacts. Voice lacks natural micro-tremors, pitch variation is artificially narrow, and 16kHz cutoff indicates AI text-to-speech generation.
